answer: Each new identity must buy an admission ticket whose price climbs with every ticket the protocol has ever sold. It burns 100 POA times 1.02 to the power of tickets already sold, so the next n identities cost 5000*(1.02^n-1) POA whenever they are bought: about 31,000 for 100 and 100 million for 500. Tickets are bound to one key and cannot be pooled or resold. Slow buying does not help, because the counter never decays. A lone pearl in a delta of clones pays its place on one public curve, and an orchard of fake identities costs more with every single tree.
